title: DAC
text: Configures the DAC to generate an analog output on the specified DAC channel A/B/C (12-bit), 1 input, {Saturate on input overflow (>4095)} sets The option to saturate the input value; {DAC channel}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: DAC channel
params.values: The DAC channel to generate analog output 12 (default)

params.name: Saturate on input overflow (>4095)
params.values: The option to saturate the input value on input overflow off | on
